blocks.text: Sanitary Care Products Asia’s Baby care product, Punaas held its first Punaas Playdate at FantasyWorld in SM Seaside City Cebu on October 2, 2026, using the event to introduce its newly launched Babiee diaper line to Cebu families alongside its existing wipes line. The event gathered mothers and children for a day of play across multiple activity areas while brand representatives walked parents through the construction and features of the new diaper. Playdate with Punaas products The Playdate format was built around keeping children occupied while giving parents an unhurried opportunity to learn about the product.
